title: POC decision heatmap & week-by-week sprint catalog - Acme Retail
body:
Context / elevator:
This doc is the working sprint catalog and decision heatmap for the Acme Retail POC (search + summarization + document retrieval). Goal: validate model selections, latency targets, and integration design for retrieval-augmented chat within 8 weeks. This is intentionally a mix of checklist, timeline, and risks so SEs, engineers, and the customer PM can iterate quickly.

Quick goals (customer-agreed):
- Demonstrate 95th percentile latency < 350ms for 512-token responses on dedicated pool
- End-to-end QA pass for doc ingestion -> retrieval -> generation with sample retail catalog (100k docs)
- Measure cost-per-conversation & provide batching/quantization recommendation
- Propose deployment model (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) with TCO estimate

Success criteria / acceptance (short):
- Closed loop: Customer queries returned with accurate citations >= 80% on evaluation set
- SLOs validated under 50 concurrent sessions during bench tests
- Ops runbook, rollout plan, and security checklist reviewed by customer security

Stakeholders (roles):
- Customer PM: Jordan Mills (Acme)
- SE Lead: Aisha Patel (owner)
- SWE (integration): Marco Chen
- Infra / Dedicated: Eric Wong
- Prompt & Eval: Lena Gomez
- Customer Security SME: Priya Singh
- Sales Sponsor: Naomi Park

Meeting cadence / channels:
- Weekly sync: Tue 11:00 PST (internal + customer alternating weeks)
- Tech deep-dive: Wed 14:00 PST (engineering only)
- Slack channel: #poc-acme-retail (add: @naomipark, @jordanmills)

High-level timeline (8-week catalog, weeks numbered relative to kickoff):
- Week 0 (onboarding & infra baseline):
  - Tasks: create project in console, provision dev sandbox, share S3 sample exports, confirm data retention policy. Owner: Eric.
  - Outputs: sandbox creds, ingestion script stub, initial capacity estimate.

- Week 1 (ingest + baseline model eval):
  - Tasks: run bulk ingest (10k docs), run baseline retrieval tests, run two model variants (open-quantized + float32) on hosted API to get latency/cost baseline. Owner: Marco / Lena.
  - Open: confirm PII scan scope (security) -> Priya to get final spec.

- Week 2 (prompt engineering + eval harness):
  - Tasks: establish eval sets (intent buckets), create automated eval harness to track accuracy/precision of citations. Owner: Lena.
  - Decision point: nominate primary model for canary. If accuracy < threshold, try alternative quantization.

- Week 3 (scaling + dedicated perf tests):
  - Tasks: spin dedicated instance (if approved), run load tests to 50 concurrent sessions, profile KV cache effectiveness, collect token-level cost. Owner: Eric.
  - Risk trigger: if 95p latency > 500ms, fall back to smaller sequence length or cache tweak.

- Week 4 (integrations & fallback policies):
  - Tasks: wire webhooks, error handling, function/tool calling smoke tests, define routing policies (region/cost/latency). Owner: Marco.
  - Deliverable: integration checklist & sample webhook payloads.

- Week 5 (customer UAT & canary rollout):
  - Tasks: run UAT with customer QA, collect qualitative feedback, enable canary traffic (10%). Owner: Aisha + Jordan.
  - Decision point: proceed to full traffic if no major regressions and cost within estimate.

- Week 6 (optimize & cost recommendations):
  - Tasks: run Redwood Optimize suggestions, test quantization profiles, tune batching, record before/after unit cost. Owner: Lena + Platform.

- Week 7 (deliverables & handoff):
  - Tasks: produce final report (TCO, SLOs, recommended deployment), ops runbook, security review artifacts. Owner: Aisha + Priya.

- Week 8 (wrap / next-steps):
  - Tasks: executive readout, contract/quote for Dedicated or Private if requested, create postmortem and roadmap items.

Task tracker (working, quick view):
- Provision dev sandbox (Eric) — status: done (2025-01-15)
- Data export from Acme (customer) — status: waiting (Jordan)
- PII scope signoff (Priya) — status: in_review
- Eval harness v0 (Lena) — status: started
- Dedicated capacity quote (Infra) — status: draft
- Error-handling / webhook schema (Marco) — status: todo

Decision heatmap (priority x confidence):
- Deployment mode (hosted/dedicated/private): HIGH priority, MED confidence -> action: create cost delta table (Week 3)
- Model quantization profile: MED priority, LOW confidence -> action: test 3 profiles in Week 1-2
- Caching strategy (prefix vs KV lifetime): HIGH priority, MED confidence -> action: run synthetic cache-hit experiments in Week 3
- Citation policy (strict vs best-effort): MED priority, HIGH confidence -> action: default strict, tune during UAT

Risk register (top 6):
- Customer data delays -> Mitigation: start with synthetic subset; parallelize ingestion. Owner: Aisha.
- PII / compliance hurdles -> Mitigation: early security review + redaction pipelines. Owner: Priya.
- Unexpected token cost -> Mitigation: early cost projection + test quantization. Owner: Lena.
- Latency spike under concurrency -> Mitigation: dedicated perf testing + fallback routing. Owner: Eric.
- Integration mismatch (webhook schema) -> Mitigation: share sample payloads and tests. Owner: Marco.
- Eval label noise -> Mitigation: small human-in-loop triage during Week 2-5. Owner: Jordan.

Escalation grid (who to ping):
- Blocker (customer downtime or legal hold): escalate to Naomi Park (sales), CC: VP of SE, Legal.
- Performance SLO breach during bench: escalate to Eric Wong (Infra), platform oncall.
- Security concern: escalate to Priya Singh and Security Pager.

Deliverables (artifact list):
- Week 1: ingest logs, baseline metrics (latency/cost).
- Week 3: dedicated perf report + KV cache experiment csv.
- Week 5: UAT feedback matrix (customer), bug list.
- Week 7: final recommendations doc (PDF), ops runbook (markdown), cost delta spreadsheet.

Open questions (explicit, for next sync):
1) Does Acme want data residency (EU-only)? Jordan to confirm by 2025-01-20.
2) Are there non-negotiable PII types (SSN, credit card)? Priya to circulate checklist.
3) Is the canonical store Elasticsearch or Postgres? Marco to propose during integration deep-dive.

Decisions log (live):
- 2025-01-12: Kickoff confirmed; initial hosted baseline approved. (Aisha)
- 2025-01-16: Dev sandbox provisioned; ingestion script created (Eric)

Notes / quick todos (notes-to-self style):
- Add synthetic user journeys to eval harness (Lena)
- Attach sample webhook payload to Confluence page (Marco)
- Prep short one-pager for Naomi on cost delta (Aisha)
- Remind customer to share sample taxonomy and product IDs

Appendix / templates referenced:
- Ingestion template: git://redwood/poctemplates/ingest-sample.py
- Eval harness: CONFLUENCE-ACME-POC-8421/evals
